WITH BusinessDate AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
MIN(BusinessDateSK) As BusinessDateSk
FROM (
    SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSk FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure FLRE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSk) BusinessDateSk FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance FLOB

) a )

--SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(AccountID)) FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) --- 113021
--SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(AccountID)) FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) --- 274868


SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(DCA.AccountID))
FROM  DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountName,AccountStatus,ProfitCostCode,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS')  DDA ON DCA.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountHolderTypeName, AccountHolderTypeSk FROM DW.DimAccountHolderType --WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
) DDAH ON DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK = DDAH.AccountHolderTypeSK
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchName,Area,Region,BranchSk FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDB ON DCA.BranchSk = DDB.BranchSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK, ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') DDAP ON DCA.AccountSk = DDAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup, ProductName, ProductSk FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DP ON DDAP.ProductSk = DP.ProductSk
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK,AccountSk,TotalRelationshipExposureFull,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate)) FLRE ON  DCA.AccountSk = FLRE.Accountsk
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK,AmortizationAmount,InterestAmount,PenaltyAmount,OutstandingBalanceFull,OutstandingBalanceProrated,AccountSk FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate)) FLOB ON  DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
---LEFT JOIN BusinessDate BD ON FLRE.BusinessDateSK = BD.BusinessDateSK AND FLOB.BusinessDateSK = BD.BusinessDateSK
--WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --- 369353
WHERE DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
AND (FLRE.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) OR FLRE.BusinessDateSK IS NULL)
AND (FLOB.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) OR FLOB.BusinessDateSK IS NULL)
(FLRE.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) OR FLRE.BusinessDateSK IS NULL) AND (FLOB.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) OR FLRE.BusinessDateSK IS NULL) AND
DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS';
